summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called ARO-ALK7 in adults with obesity, both with and without type 2 diabetes mellitus, which is a condition that causes high blood sugar. The trial is sponsored by Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals and aims to enroll 150 participants. This is a Phase 1/2 study that is currently Recruiting. The study looks at different doses of the drug given alone or combined with another medicine called tirzepatide.
